mechanism_narrative: A higher-than-trend FEDFUNDS rate at the decision point predicts a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to immediate market anticipation of tighter policy.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are positive or flat when FEDFUNDS crosses above its 5-month average, with p-value > 0.05 in a two-tailed test.

mechanism_narrative: Rising monthly PAYEMS (employment) coincides with a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as labor market strength supports corporate optimism and investment.
failure_condition: Payrolls show no correlation with SPX 60-day returns or rank interaction < 0.05 over 5-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in HOUST (residential construction) at the decision date predicts a positive 20-day SPX return via expectations of sustained economic growth.
failure_condition: No statistically significant positive return (t-test p > 0.05) when HOUST growth is not above 5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A contraction in INDPRO (industrial production) below trend predicts a negative 5-day SPX forward return as weak manufacturing signals risk aversion.
failure_condition: INDPRO remains above trend for 5 consecutive months with SPX 5-day returns non-negative.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive monthly declines in RSAFS (commercial paper) and a rising CPIAUCSL together produce a positive 20-day SPX return via risk-off/risk-on trade-off in the term structure.
failure_condition: No significant return (p > 0.05) when both conditions are not met or interaction rank < 0.01.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE (unemployment) below 4.5% triggers a positive 60-day SPX return as labor market tightness boosts equity valuations.
failure_condition: No positive 60-day return when UNRATE remains ≥ 4.5% for 30 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in GDPC1 (GDP) and HOUST (housing) over the prior quarter predict a positive 20-day SPX return as dual demand signals boost optimism.
failure_condition: No significant return (p > 0.05) when both proxies show no quarterly growth or interaction rank < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A prolonged decline in GDPC1 (GDP) over the last 3 months predicts a negative 5-day SPX return as weak aggregate demand suppresses equity valuations.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are non-negative when GDPC1 shows steady or rising growth over the prior 3 months.
